# Concepts and Applications of Machine Learning

This site hosts public course material for **DS 3030** at Iowa State University.

## Course content

- [Lecture slides](lectures/index.qmd)

## Authoring workflow

Course pages and slides are written in [Quarto](https://quarto.org/).
Lecture slide decks live in `/lectures`, can include R code chunks, and are published as HTML through GitHub Pages.
